TrainingRightsAssessment: NO_LICENSE_FOUND: GitHub public visibility is not a licence. Default copyright applies; no reuse grant.
VerificationEvidence: GitHub API 2026-11-26: 185 files, no LICENSE file, no licence field.
DuplicateRelationship: Overlaps PayloadsAllTheThings by the same author
DataQualityAssessment: Technically strong (would be Tier A on content) but legally unusable.
AcceptanceConditions: Written permission from the author is required.
RecommendedAction: Quarantine; seek permission

Name: UNSW-NB15 (Kaggle mirror)
Description: Kaggle mirror of the UNSW-NB15 benchmark with flow features and labels.
TrainingRightsAssessment: LICENSE_VERIFIED_RESTRICTED: NonCommercial + ShareAlike. Cannot be used if the resulting model is offered commercially without separate permission.
CommercialUseStatus: Prohibited for commercial use as licensed
VerificationEvidence: Kaggle metadata 2026-11-26: licence CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, size 12.3 MB.
DuplicateRelationship: Mirror of UNSW-NB15 (also on Dataverse as V3) — not an independent dataset

AcceptanceConditions: Non-commercial only; count once with the Dataverse copy.

Name: Kitsune Network Attack Dataset (Kaggle)
Description: Packet-level attack captures used to evaluate the Kitsune online NIDS, covering nine attack types on IoT devices.
TrainingRightsAssessment: LICENSE_VERIFIED_RESTRICTED: AGPL-3.0 on a dataset is unusual and ambiguous; strong copyleft plus network-use clause creates real risk. Requires legal review.
DataQualityAssessment: High-quality PCAPs from a controlled testbed; 64 GB dominated by binary captures.
AcceptanceConditions: Legal opinion on AGPL for data required before any use.
RecommendedAction: Hold
